## Google Sheet Data Checker

Webhook-driven mock validator for the Agent Operations Portal demo.

Contract:
- Inbound: spec §12.1 (execution_id, callback{url,secret}, config.required_columns)
- Callback: spec §12.2 (status, metrics, result)
- Result schema: spec §14.4 (rows_checked, invalid_rows, issues[].row|field|issue, summary)

Deterministic 100-row mock with 7 planted defects so the same input yields the same digest. config.required_columns is comma-separated; missing values for any listed column become an issue. Email format and age range are always validated.
